# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
The verified incumbent is timing-feasible at 85 LUTs, 203 FFs, WNS 0.709 ns, and WHS 0.108 ns, so iteration 3 must strictly reduce LUTs to improve the `minimize_luts` objective. Iterations 1 and 2 were accepted; the seed already includes narrowed accumulator stages, and the top requires `// @latency 5`. The advisor’s missing-I/O-delay note reflects the fixed out-of-context constraints, which time internal clocked paths only.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the wide rounded-result comparisons with a 17-bit quotient and sign-extension checks may reduce saturation logic LUTs while preserving exact rounding and clipping.

## Instruction for generator
In `fir16_sym_core`, express the rounded result as a signed 17-bit quotient using the exact `acc4[27:11] + acc4[10]` identity, then replace comparisons against ±32767/32768 with checks of quotient bits `[16:15]`: `01` saturates positive, `10` saturates negative, and `00`/`11` pass through the low 16 bits. Preserve the existing registered `data5`, elastic-slot enables, reset behavior, and top `// @latency 5`; retain the current 28-bit accumulator because its full signed range is part of the exact arithmetic. This targets LUT reduction, but only matching routed reports and all required verification gates can establish improvement.
